texto: Recognize verbs with particles and combine them with frequent prepositions. **Vi kom överens om tiden** means «We agreed on the time.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
